def solve3(g, wall):
    # wall = marker color; bg = the other color; fill=2
    o=[row[:] for row in g]; R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    others=set(v for row in g for v in row)-{wall,2}
    bg=list(others)[0] if len(others)==1 else None
    assert bg is not None, others
    def mark(cells, lo, hi, edge_side):
        seg=cells
        # two-sided bounded
        if lo is not None and hi is not None:
            if len(seg)<=6:
                for (r,c) in seg: o[r][c]=2
        else:
            # one-sided + edge: fill all except edge-adjacent cell
            if len(seg)<=6:
                for (r,c) in seg:
                    if edge_side=='top' and r==0: continue
                    if edge_side=='bot' and r==R-1: continue
                    if edge_side=='left' and c==0: continue
                    if edge_side=='right' and c==C-1: continue
                    o[r][c]=2
    for r in range(R):
        runs=[]; s=None
        for c in range(C+1):
            v=g[r][c] if c<C else None
            if v==bg and s is None: s=c
            elif v!=bg and s is not None:
                lo = r,c-1 if c>0 and g[r][c-1]==wall else (r,None)[1]
                hi = c if c<C and g[r][c]==wall else None
                edge = 'left' if (lo is None and (c-1==s or s==0)) else None
                mark([(r,x) for x in range(s,c)], r-1 if False else None, None, edge or ('right' if (hi is None) else None))
                s=None
    # vertical pass analogous
    for c in range(C):
        s=None
        for r in range(R+1):
            v=g[r][c] if r<R else None
            if v==bg and s is None: s=r
            elif v!=bg and s is not None:
                lo = r-1 if r>0 and g[r-1][c]==wall else None
                hi = r if r<R and g[r][c]==wall else None
                edge = 'top' if (lo is None and s==0) else ('bot' if hi is None else None)
                mark([(x,c) for x in range(s,r)], None, None, edge)
                s=None
    return o
